problem: The forward reference "see Unit 4 for modular arithmetic inside these blocks" is vague: it does not say which chapter, it breaks the book's habit of linking chapters, and "inside these blocks" is loose. Arithmetic modulo m is defined on the classes (the quotient set ℤ/mℤ), not inside a single class.
fix: Replace with: "Congruence classes modulo m are the blocks of a partition of the integers. Addition and multiplication of these classes are covered in the modular arithmetic chapter." Link to that chapter with an <a href="#chapter-id"> tag if it exists.
